verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents SAML-based single sign-on, so users can sign in once with their managed Google account and reach their company's cloud apps, including custom apps outside the pre-integrated catalog. That covers the 'sign in once' half of the story. The evidence never shows an employee-facing launcher dashboard, a browser extension, or a per-user view of assigned apps. Missing for 10: documented employee app-launcher portal, browser extension for app access, evidence of showing only apps assigned to the user, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, one portal holds my work apps — a launcher dashboard (and browser extension) where I sign in once and reach everything I'm assigned

citations.quote: L'authentification unique (SSO) permet aux utilisateurs de se connecter à toutes les applications cloud de leur entreprise à l'aide des identifiants de leur compte Google géré.
প্রি-ইন্টিগ্রেটেড ক্যাটালগে নেই এমন একটি কাস্টম অ্যাপের সাথে SAML-ভিত্তিক SSO সেট আপ করতে এই ধাপগুলি অনুসরণ করুন।
